FERRARI CERTIFIED PRE-OWNED | FERRARI APPROVED

This 2009 Ferrari Scuderia 16M Spider has been certified as Ferrari Classiche — the brand’s highest department of excellence, created to protect the invaluable heritage that these cars represent.

Presented in the stunning and classic special order color Nero Nero DS 1250, this 16M carries Racing Seats in carbon fiber and Alcantara Nera— including Cavallino stitched headrests and full special stitching in Giallo throughout. Pristine condition throughout. Sold new by our dealership and maintained exclusively by our factory-trained technicians throughout its ownership.

Ferrari of Puerto Rico is the island's sole Official Ferrari Dealership — an authorized franchise of Ferrari S.p.A., staffed by Ferrari-certified technicians and dedicated to delivering the complete Ferrari ownership experience. Every vehicle we offer has been inspected, serviced, and prepared to the exacting standards of Maranello. When you acquire through us, you are acquiring with the full confidence of the factory behind you.

If you are in the market for a Ferrari 16M Spider, we invite you to contact our team today. Call +1 (787) 296-9996 or inquire online — our specialists are available to assist you personally.
